**Risk flags:**

- Only 1 year(s) of financials available  

**Overview:**  
Bestari Kirana Ladang Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company operating in the agriculture sector, specifically oil palm plantation and fresh fruit bunch supply, based in Selangor. It was incorporated on 2023‑08‑11 and has a paid‑up share capital of RM 2,500,000. The firm reports RM 62,464,139 in revenue and equity of RM 45,948,581, with four directors on its board. The largest shareholder controls 52.86% of the company, and there are no recorded legal cases against it.
